_how_to_fill: 1. Run the synthesis flow of this repository (Vivado, Artix-7 XC7A25T):
vivado -mode batch -source scripts/vivado_synth.tcl                              (dct8_core, W = 14, Table 1 micro-rotations, 6.9 ns clock)
vivado -mode batch -source scripts/vivado_synth.tcl -tclargs dct8_core 14 1 6.9  (the same with the CORDIC-II unit)
2. Copy this file to artifact/data/fpga_measured.json and replace every null with the value read from the reports in build/vivado_dct8_core_w14_m<mode>/ :
lut       utilization.rpt, row 'Slice LUTs', column Used
ff        utilization.rpt, row 'Slice Registers', column Used
fmax_mhz  timing.rpt, Design Timing Summary: 1000 / (clock period in ns - WNS in ns); the period is the last argument of the run (6.9 by default)
power_mw  power.rpt, 'Total On-Chip Power (W)' times 1000 (default switching activity)
tool      the Vivado version that ran, for example 'Vivado 2024.2'
config    what was run, for example 'dct8_core W=14 MR_MODE=0 SS=000, 6.9 ns clock, out of context'
wl        the word length W of the run
The build stops with a message if a field is missing, empty or of the wrong kind; the red 'pending' row of the FPGA table is replaced by the measured row.
The keys that start with an underscore are ignored.
